# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the time of Nell's arrival; died several years later  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Grey Shutters, Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby’s husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame and hunching shoulders. He possessed lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders and wore a thick, gentle brown beard that remained on his face continually from the age of twenty. On rare special occasions, he dressed in a fine suit accompanied by a white collar.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031)_

## Personality

Obed was extremely bashful, quiet, and timid, thoroughly despising being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where conversation was required. He feared almost every woman, except his sister Thirza and Agatha Sowerby, feeling uneasy that they were secretly mocking him. Despite his quiet nature, he held a remarkably stubborn resolve whenever he fixed his heart on something, and he possessed a deep, quiet affection and sympathy for children.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021)_

## History

Obed Abernethy resided at Grey Shutters with his sister Thirza. Seeking farm assistance due to advancing age, heart trouble, and scarce hired labor, he persuaded Thirza to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia. When he drove to Alder River station to collect the child, he was bewildered to find a talkative, red-haired girl named Nell Harcourt instead. Unable to break the news to her immediately, he brought her back to Grey Shutters and quietly insisted on retaining her despite Thirza's initial objections. Over the following years, Obed developed a deep, indulgent affection for Nell, secretly supporting her desires, comforting her during punishments, and purchasing gifts such as sweeties and a stylish new dress for her. When Nell faced a night-time emergency treating a child with croup, Obed drove through the frozen night to bring a physician from Tullyvale. Years later, after experiencing worsening heart spells, Obed received a letter announcing the failure of the Abbey Bank where all their life savings were kept. The sudden shock triggered a fatal heart attack, and he collapsed in the porch doorway of Grey Shutters, dying instantly.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 c12 P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 c18 P22](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0022), [v1 c18 P32](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0032), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P33](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0033), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Raised at Grey Shutters by a father who was as bashful and quiet as himself  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
